# Concise English-Irish Dictionary

![Click here to buy our Concise English-Irish Dictionary](https://focloir.ie/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fthumb4.jpg&w=640&q=75)

![Click here to buy our Concise English-Irish Dictionary](https://focloir.ie/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fthumb5.jpg&w=640&q=75)

The Concise English-Irish Dictionary was published in 2020. The Concise English-Irish Dictionary was derived from the New English-Irish Dictionary which is available on this website.

In the print version users will find:

- 30,000 entries
- 85,000 sense units
- 200,000 phrases and example sentences in Irish
- a large style and grammar supplement

The book’s RRP is €30/£25.

[![Click here to buy our Concise English-Irish Dictionary](https://focloir.ie/_next/image?url=%2Fimages%2Fen%2Fbuyme.png&w=640&q=75)](https://www.forasnagaeilge.ie/focloir/?lang=en)

There is a language and grammar supplement in the printed version. PDF versions of this material, in both Irish and English, are available to download [here](https://focloir.ie/additional-resources).

Click on the icons below to see some more of the secondary material included in the dictionary.
